about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client in Ta' Xbiex for a reliable and hands-on Maintenance Person to join their team.

You will carry out general maintenance, basic repairs and routine inspections so the company's facilities stay safe, functional and well maintained — including assisting with basic electrical and plumbing works and responding promptly to maintenance requests.

The role suits someone practical and proactive who is happy to work independently after an initial training and induction period. It is full-time and on-site with a competitive salary, reduced working hours in summer, health insurance and sponsorship for professional qualifications.
responsibilities: Carry out general maintenance tasks and minor repairs
Assist with basic electrical and plumbing works
Conduct routine inspections and identify maintenance requirements
Respond to maintenance requests and resolve issues promptly
Keep facilities, equipment and work areas in good condition
Identify and report any issues requiring specialist attention
Follow health and safety procedures when carrying out maintenance work
Work with the team to ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of the facilities
requirements: Previous experience in maintenance, repairs or a similar role is considered an advantage
Practical problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach
Reliable, organised and committed to maintaining high standards
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Positive attitude and willingness to learn
offer: Reduced working hours during the summer period
Sponsorship for professional qualifications and training
Opportunities for professional development in a supportive working environment
preferred: Previous experience in maintenance, repairs or a similar role
